description: Synthetic 400x600 RGB JPEG with a thin white left margin and a varying right edge. No user artwork.
profile: JDK 21 ICC_Profile.getInstance(ColorSpace.CS_LINEAR_RGB), inserted as an actual ICC_PROFILE APP2 JPEG segment
goldenMethod: Decode the untagged JPEG, interpret its raw RGB channels through CS_LINEAR_RGB.toRGB, round to sRGB 8-bit channels. Golden does not call the production decoder.
